name: Pinpoint Shot
body:
Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): You gain a damage bonus equal to your Dexterity modifier when attacking with a bow or crossbow at ranges up to 30 ft. This bonus does not stack with any other ability modifier to damage such as the Strength bonus granted when using a composite bow.
